acceptance: Parquet-loaded TPC-H SF 0.01 passes the live differential suite
context:
Item-specific guardrails: read-only mounts only; CSV COPY remains the default until measured.

Shared SereneDB guardrails: worktree-only repository writes with make agent-write-preflight; explicit-path staging, never git add -A; commit identity check, no attribution trailers; uv only, no new dependency; lazy psycopg import; no credentials in Git, logs, fixtures, or tracker; Mocker never in CI and its timings never published; pin by digest or exact version and record version(); announce long runs and never commit raw logs; code-skill self-review then make pr-preflight and make pr-open, no auto-merge without make pr-ready; durable artifacts carry no tracker IDs or session narrative; stop and report on failed gates, unverified behavior, or unapproved host changes.
description:
SereneDB reads Parquet natively (`read_parquet`, CTAS). The adapter inherits the PostgreSQL path, which streams Parquet as CSV through COPY FROM STDIN. A native path needs the server to see the files: a bind-mounted data directory, or remote storage.

Tasks:
1. Check whether server-side `read_parquet` can reach BenchBox data through a read-only bind mount in the dev compose stack.
2. Implement a Parquet load branch behind a platform option. Keep COPY FROM STDIN as the default.
3. Compare load time and verify DATE and DECIMAL type fidelity. Pass differential validation after a Parquet load.

Decision gates:
- G1 Start only with explicit user priority.
- G2 Mounts must be read-only and limited to the data directory. No object-store or HTTP exposure of local data without approval.
- G3 Change the default format only if Parquet is faster and answers are identical.
